Subject: Commencement address - Lakeview College

Dear team,

Lakeview College invites your CEO to deliver the commencement address on May 15, 2027 at Lakeview Stadium in Madison, WI. About 5,000 graduates and guests will attend. President Maria Gonzalez will introduce the speaker.

Sincerely,
Owen Fitzgerald
Chief of Staff, Lakeview College
